meta.name: normalize
meta.description: Normalize design to match your design system and ensure consistency

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将设计稿自动匹配你的设计系统，确保视觉一致性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要统一设计风格并减少手动校对
copy.tagline_en: Normalize designs to match your design system and ensure visual consistency
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to unify design styles and reduce manual checks

howto.what: 当你说“帮我规范化这个页面”时，Claude 会分析当前页面或功能，找出与设计系统不一致的地方，然后自动调整样式、组件和布局，使其符合你的设计规范。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 对某个页面、路由或功能进行设计规范化时触发。

say.text: 帮我规范化这个登录页面
say.note: Claude 会分析并调整登录页面的设计。

say.text: 把仪表盘的设计规范化
say.note: Claude 会检查仪表盘并应用设计系统标准。

howto.what_en: When you ask to normalize a page or feature, Claude analyzes it for inconsistencies with your design system and automatically adjusts styles, components, and layout to match your design standards.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to normalize a specific page, route, or feature to align with your design system.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze and adjust the login page design.
Claude will check the dashboard and apply design system standards.
